Name: Salad's Pink And Purple Cows Recolour
Author: saladcreates
Description:
Content Patcher Required.

To use this mod, siimply download the file and drag It into your "mods" folder.

Pairs nicely with the [url=http://https://www.google.com/search?client=safari&rls=en&q=cute+valley+mod&ie=UTF-8&oe=UTF-8]Cute Valley[/url]﻿ and [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21531]Cotton Candy Recolor[/url]﻿ mods!

Mod is set to make all white cows purple and all brown cows pink.
If you want all purple or all pink cows, open the content.json file and edit the assets to match whichever you would like.

Manifest.Name: Salad's Subtle Pink/Purple Cows
Manifest.Description: Changes cows to purple and pink.
